ideas.pitch: An AI-powered developer CLI extension that watches execution logs, detects runtime exceptions locally or in staging, and writes structured repair patches instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for Everyday Life track focusing on productivity, developer automation, and debugging.
ideas.title: NovaCLI Autopilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leans into Nova CLI, which the hackathon organisers explicitly mandate and highlight for building, iterating, and debugging throughout the event.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous study partner that ingests lecture PDFs and code repositories, turning them into adaptive, multi-turn Socratic quizzes with real-time concept gap analysis.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for Everyday Life track focusing on education and personal organisation.
ideas.title: NovaStudy Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets education and student productivity, which resonates strongly with hackathon judges who are often students or educators themselves.

ideas.pitch: A local-first wellness and biometric log parser that aggregates wearable exports into an explainable daily recovery dashboard with automated sleep hygiene prompts.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for Everyday Life track focusing on health and wellness.
ideas.title: NovaHealth Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on personal health and practical everyday utility, aligning directly with the track requirement to solve tangible human problems.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent multi-modal travel planner that factors in real-time disruptions, budget constraints, and personal preferences to build complete day-by-day itineraries.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for Everyday Life track focusing on travel and communication.
ideas.title: NovaRoute AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a consumer-facing AI application with an end-to-end user flow that can be impressively demoed live in under two minutes.

ideas.pitch: An edge-compute receipt scanner and expense categoriser that flags subscription anomalies and tax-deductible items automatically using local vision models.
ideas.problem_statement: AI for Everyday Life track focusing on personal finance and automation.
ideas.title: NovaFinance Receipt Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a universally experienced personal pain point with a polished UI and a functioning demo that works instantly on sample data.
